Rolls-Royce is hiring a Software Development Infrastructure Engineer (Controls Operations Engineer) for its Integrated Controls Systems capability group. The role supports and maintains the engineering development environment, including IT infrastructure, platform integration, security, and systems lifecycle needs.

No H1B

Responsibilities
Assisting in the administration, configuration, and support virtual machines, and physical machines
Helping design, manage, and support engineering development, project management, and team collaboration software
Documenting infrastructure configurations, procedures, and changes
Troubleshooting platform issues in collaboration with infrastructure and solution support architects
Conducting security vulnerability remediation using Linux/Windows diagnostic tools to trace active processes, assess system dependencies, and execute safe mitigation plans without disrupting live production services
Providing support in the design and deployment of Department of Defense’s Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC), a mandatory verification framework to protect sensitive defense information

Required
Bachelor's degree in mechanical or aerospace, and/or related degree
+ Educated at degree level in STEM subjects, including Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering
Foundational understanding of networking concepts, server architecture, infrastructure / platform engineering, and virtualization / cloud concepts (especially VMware)
Experience in Linux and Windows Server environments
Knowledge in Linux ecosystems and configuration management (e.g., Ansible) to drive automated, centralized deployments across the infrastructure
Experience querying and managing databases
Excellent attention to detail, self-motivation, problem solving skills, and ability for written and oral communication to a variety of audiences (e.g. team members, technical experts, and management)
Knowledge of IT best practices (ITIL) for system monitoring, configuration management, enterprise tools, or improving and aligning services with business objectives
An infrastructure-as-software mindset focused on observability, utilizing log tracking to understand system behavior and identifying critical areas for monitoring and redundancy
Minimum GPA: 3.0
To be considered, you must also be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a high-level security clearance
Graduating between May 2026 and December 2026
Preferred
Knowledge of IT best practices (ITIL) for system monitoring, configuration management, enterprise tools, or improving and aligning services with business objectives
An infrastructure-as-software mindset focused on observability, utilizing log tracking to understand system behavior and identifying critical areas for monitoring and redundancy
Benefits
A discretionary bonus plan
Eligible employees may have the opportunity to enroll in health, dental, vision, disability, life, and accidental death & dismemberment insurance; a flexible spending account; a health savings account; a 401(k) retirement savings plan with a company match; Employee Assistance Program; Paid Time Off; certain paid holidays; paid parental and family care leave; tuition reimbursement; and a long-term incentive plan. Options available may vary based on eligibility factors such as date of hire, employment type, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.
Meaningful work from day one, with support to help you succeed
A culture that invests in your personal and professional development
The chance to grow your skills while working on real projects in a global company
